questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some handkerchiefs are plastics.

All clothes are handkerchiefs.

All utensils are clothes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some plastics are handkerchiefs.

II. All utensils are plastics.

III. Some handkerchiefs are utensils.

options.text: Only Conclusions I and III follow.
Only Conclusions II and III follow.
Only Conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f55ecd52006c6ab7ee085a1e708e196f5493828a57913f923dfaa881b09d12eb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some plastics are handkerchiefs → True (As Some handkerchiefs are plastics so, Some plastics are handkerchiefs is true)

II. All utensils are plastics → False (As All utensils are clothes and All clothes are handkerchiefs and Some handkerchiefs are plastics so, All utensils are plastics is false)

III. Some handkerchiefs are utensils → True (As All utensils are clothes and All clothes are handkerchiefs so, Some handkerchiefs are utensils is true)

∴ Here, Conclusions I and III are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only Conclusions I and III follow".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

2531 : 121 :: 1446 : ? :: 3506 : 196
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(Sum of digits of first number)² = Second number.

 
• 2531 : 121 → (2 + 5 + 3 + 1)² = 11² = 121
 
• 3506 : 196 → (3 + 5 + 0 + 6)² = 14² = 196
 
• **1446 : ? → (1 + 4 + 4 + 6)² = 15²** **= 225**

Hence, the correct answer is **"225".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

b _ c _ d _ k b _ _ a _ e k b b _ a d _ k

options.text: b a e b c d e c
b e a b c d c e
b a e b c d c e
b a e d c d c k

questions.solution:
Given :- b _ c _ d _ k b _ _ a _ e k b b _ a d _ k

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) b a e b c d e c → b **a** c **a** d **e** k b **b c** a **d** e k b b **e** a d **c** k → No particular pattern

2) b e a b c d c e → b **b** c **e** d **a** k b **b** **c** a **d** e k b b **c** a d **e** k → No particular pattern

3) b a e b c d c e → b **b** c **a** d **e** k - b **b c** a **d** e k - b b **c** a d **e** k → Particular pattern followed

 
• Here **"bbcadek"** is repeated.

4) b a e d c d c k → b **b** c **a** d **e** k b **d c** a **d** e k b b **c** a d **k** k → No particular pattern

 
• **Option (3)** gives the pattern of- b b c a d e k - b b c a d e k - b b c a d e k

Hence, the correct answer is **"b a e b c d c e".**

questions.question: In a family, N's wife H is the only daughter of G. D and R are brothers. J's father is married to P's daughter. V's only sister G is married to P. R is the son of P. Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: V is the paternal aunt of H.
G is the father of N.
P is the maternal grandfather of J.
D is the son of N.

questions.solution:
Family chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfe58a866de19111e9f027b51db233fbff40ff501e4953d38a14a4d5aa865d10.png] 

Family Tree :

1) N's wife H is the only daughter of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdc20ee6595fdfc1bbf3a8697d9968ffc093aae019d0587ab365090f0ac0bb3.png] 

2) V's only sister G is married to P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/640c35cd11ab3d82a846bfd5b455e65d4b170f6a4eaea3918f6ad3a8c3bf8bdd.png] 

3) R is the son of P and D and R are brothers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0c33e4769b12a676195e0fc6d114490d06e808a5068eb8799b47cea63396842.png] 

4) J's father is married to P's daughter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e0cb70a75633d914f877143dde6ba0137eb268af5e13daa906da222e19e9be9.png] 

**Options :**

1) V is the paternal aunt of H → False (As N's wife H is the only daughter of G and V's only sister G is married to P, here gender of 'V' is not determined so, V is the paternal aunt of H is false)

2) G is the father of N → False (As N's wife H is the only daughter of G, G is the mother - in - law of N )

3) P is the maternal grandfather of J → True (As H is the only daughter of G. and J's father is married to P's daughter so, P is the maternal grandfather of J is true)

4) D is the son of N → False (As N's wife H is the only daughter of G and V's only sister G is married to P and R is the son of P and D and R are brothers → D is brother to N so, false)

Hence, the correct answer is **"P is the maternal grandfather of J".**

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36ef3af1935e65744670ee7ee42c5813e239516f166588cbbf93e7f1e9b6fb9c.png] 

Option 1) : +, ÷, ×, −, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 + 27 ÷ 9 × 18 - 36 = 72

⇒ 54 + __**27 ÷ 9**__ × 18 - 36 = 72

⇒ 54 + __**3 × 18**__ - 36 = 72

⇒ __**54 + 54**__ - 36 = 72

⇒ __**108 - 36**__ = 72

⇒ **72 = 72**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : −, +, ×, ÷, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 - 27 + 9 × 18 ÷ 36 = 72

⇒ 54 - 27 + 9 × __**18 ÷ 36**__ = 72

⇒ 54 - 27 + __**9 × 0.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**54**__ - 27 __**+ 4.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**58.5 - 27**__ = 72

⇒ 31.5 ≠ 72

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : +, −, ×, ÷, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 + 27 - 9 × 18 ÷ 36 = 72

⇒ 54 + 27 - 9 × __**18 ÷ 36**__ = 72

⇒ 54 + 27 - __**9 × 0.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**54 + 27**__ - 4.5 = 72

⇒ __**81 - 4.5**__ = 72

⇒ 76.5 ≠ 72

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : −, ×, +, ÷, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 - 27 × 9 + 18 ÷ 36 = 72

⇒ 54 - 27 × 9 + __**18 ÷ 36**__ = 72

⇒ 54 - __**27 × 9**__ + 0.5 = 72

⇒ __**54**__ - 243 __**+ 0.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**54.5 - 243**__ = 72

⇒ - 188.5 ≠ 72

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"+, ÷, ×, −, =".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some dolls are rockets.

Some rockets are engines.

All engines are solids.

**Conclusions:**

I. No doll is solid.

II. No solid is an engine.

III. Some dolls are solid.

IV. No engine is a rocket.

options.text: Only conclusions II and IV follow.
Either conclusion II or III follows.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Either conclusion I or III follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/453208aa0140893b5b64e67b0787ab749ce5a20aad58e6d7103ef43dd0f00945.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No doll is solid → False (As Some dolls are rockets and Some rockets are engines and All engines are solids so, No doll is solid is false) 

II. No solid is an engine → False (As All engines are solids so, No solid is an engine is false)

III. Some dolls are solid → False (As Some dolls are rockets and Some rockets are engines and All engines are solids so, Some dolls are solid is false)

IV. No engine is a rocket → False (As Some rockets are engines so, No engine is a rocket is false)

∴ Here, are **Conclusions I and III will form complementary pairs**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Either conclusion I or III follows".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

A set of two conclusions is said to be a **Complementary Pair** and thus form a case of **either or** when they follow the following conditions-

i) Both the objects must be the same in both conclusions.

ii) Both the conclusions must be False individually.

Some of the cases of complementary pairs are-

Some + No & All + Some Not 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__

**Some + Some not **is** never **a complimentary pair.
